about: How sure the model is about each feature, for the map and Overview 'Sure / unsure' overlay (docs/CONFIDENCE.md). scripts/build_confidence.py gives every feature in the shared inventory a default level; entries here override it with a reason, record the owner's decision, or mark a known gap (something visibly there that is not modelled). A level is a judgement for the game, not placement approval (docs/PLACEMENT_VERIFICATION.md).

levels.photographed: Clearly photographed: what it is and how it fits its neighbours is clear in the photos. Sizes and exact map position can still be off by up to about a metre.
levels.estimated: Seen in photos, but only partly (one angle, cropped, distant or behind planting): its shape, size or extent is estimated.
levels.inferred: Not seen directly: built from the aerial, the levels survey or what must be there.
levels.registry: Official land-registry footprint: the outline is reliable, the whole map sits about 1-1.5 m off the laser survey.

decisions.accepted: Good enough for the game; no more work planned.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-benches-aeria.why: Dave said on 11 November 2026 that Calle Jorge has more than one bench. No photo shows the others. The aerial shows white marks the size of the photographed bench on the grass 1.6 to 1.9 m off the path at about 64.3, 79.2 and 122.3 m (docs/reviews/jorge-benches-aerial/), and the photographed bench is reused there. That each mark is a bench, and which way it faces, is inferred. Open: a similar mark at 106.5 m is built as the kerbed shrub bed, and the aerial shows nothing at 112 m where the pins put the photographed bench.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-fittings.why: Square tiles, the SANEA cover and grate, slot drains at the Teodoro junction, the green cover in the grass, the dragon tree (a stout forked trunk with a ball of sword leaves on each limb, IMG_2230 and IMG_2594), the candelabra tree, house 20, the CALLE DE TEODORO plaque, the one lamp post on the kerb corner and the olive by the plinth are photographed in IMG_2183, IMG_2230, IMG_2231, IMG_2233, IMG_2234, IMG_2596 and IMG_2597. Stations are read from those pins, ±2 to ±5 m, so the positions are estimated. The candelabra tree stands on the open garden lawn about 6.8 m back from the lane; that distance, its 5.6 m height and 4.2 m spread are estimates.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-verge.why: IMG_2182, IMG_2229, IMG_2230, IMG_2233 and IMG_2234 show lawn from the path to the house fronts on the south side, an open garden lawn with a white-painted kerb on the north side, and white planters about 0.7 m high with clipped hedges, two brick thresholds and number niches in front of the patios. The lawn outlines follow the registry houses and the aerial; kerb, planter and threshold stations are read from the pins, good to about 2 m. The digits on the niche tiles are not legible and are not modelled.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-paths.why: IMG_2182, IMG_2229 and IMG_2231 show a two-tile cross-path about 1.9 m east of the bench, a second path leaving the lane west of the bench and running behind it along the house front, and a white-kerbed bed with round clipped shrubs and a strelitzia. Their distances from the bench are read from tile rows; how far back they run and where they end are estimated to about 1 m, and no camera is solved.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-west.why: IMG_2280 and IMG_2696-2698 show the west entrance from the Pintor Dalí car park: sandstone flags about 2 m wide between two white-painted kerbs, a lamp post at the end of the left kerb, lawn both sides, two round clipped trees on the north lawn, a shrub border and a house with bougainvillea on the south side, a white gateway at the far end. The aerial agrees on the lawns, tree crowns and house. Kerb length, path width and plant positions are estimated to about 1 m; the flags are built to 28 m, where the aerial shows a white mark read as the gateway.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-gateway.why: IMG_2280 and IMG_2697, enlarged, show a white gateway with a flat capped lintel, open green iron leaves, bougainvillea over it, a white wall with a hedge to its left and a flagged cross-path in front. It is seen only from 25 m away, so its size (built 1.25 m wide by 2.1 m high, measured against the round tree to about a quarter) and station (the aerial's white mark at 28 to 29 m) are estimates.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-middle.why: No photo is taken between the gateway at 28 m and about 86 m. The square-tile path is assumed to continue from the east stretch, where IMG_2234 shows it; neither the aerial nor the west photos show the path surface here. The lawns and one tree are placed from the aerial, and the north strip from 58 to 86 m, drawn as grass, reads khaki and may be bare ground or paving; the second white portal is seen through the gateway but where it stands (put at 56 m, where the house rows begin) is a guess. Walls, planters, doors and the CALLE JORGE 27 35 passage along 56 to 86 m are not built. Photo requests jorge-middle-lawn, jorge-silvia-junction, jorge-houses-56-86 and jorge-27-35-passage.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-guillermo-pla.why: IMG_2773 and IMG_2774 show a neat, straight white planter wall about a metre high along the east side of Calle Guillermo north of the Jorge junction, with a low carpet of lantana on top and a clump of yucca heads behind it; IMG_2597 shows it behind the plinth lawn. Its top is set one metre above the lane beside it (Dave, 2026-11-12: about one metre). It is set at the east edge of the mapped Guillermo line, 22 m long; its ends are not measured.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-guillermo-pav.why: IMG_2773, IMG_2774, IMG_2822 and IMG_2823 show Calle Guillermo paved wall to wall beside the planter, in large squares at the Jorge junction and octagons with square insets beyond, with a round cover and two grates. Width (2.3 m), the change from squares to octagons (about 3 m north) and the cover positions are estimated to about 0.5 m; the surface is laid level across at the lane's surveyed height.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-guillermo-wes.why: IMG_2773 and IMG_2774 show a plain white wall along the north side of the plinth lawn, its top falling from about 3.9 m to about 2.6 m at the lane, a no-dogs sign near its end, then hedged planters with gateways, a taller patio wall behind, two lamp posts and a brick border along the lane. On 12 November Dave agreed to treat the east portion of registry part 6364401UF1366S_part7, behind that wall, as an open walled patio on the photo evidence, without a measured check (data/registry_corrections.json). Positions are good to about 1 to 1.5 m; where the roofed west block ends is not seen in any photo. Dave has not yet looked at the result.

jorge_lane.json:jorge-lane-planting.why: IMG_2229, IMG_2230, IMG_2697 and IMG_2773 show bougainvillea in full purple bract on the house fronts and spilling over the lawn wall, a small grey-green tree by the house-23 bed, a light-green broad-leaved tree on the plinth lawn, a row of low clipped shrubs along the flagged west path, and lawns of a darker, duller green than first modelled. What each plant is and roughly where is photographed; positions are good to about 1.5 m and sizes are estimated. Dave has not yet looked at the result.
